overall_reason: The save demo chains a press, a spinner and a check in one 14 px slot while the label rolls from 'Save' to 'Saving' to 'Saved', each step fading in 160 to 180 ms; this is feedback in causal order, and the spinner loop shows a real state.

score.reason: T-CONTINUITY, T-LOOPS and T-MOTION-SYSTEM pass; the spinner's first frames and its delay fall between stills, so the score stops short of 9.

strengths: At about 1.6 s the button shows its press (darker background, 1 px smaller box) before the label changes, so press feedback comes before the result.
The icon, spinner and check share one slot and fade over 160 to 180 ms, the label rolls through ss-roll, and the button holds its 92 px width through all three states.
The 800 ms spinner loop runs only while saving (animation-play-state stays paused otherwise), so the loop shows a state, not decoration.
not_investigated: MOT-200 and MOT-258: whether the spinner is already turning when it becomes visible, and its delay before showing, fall between the 1.6 s and 2.6 s stills.
The sweep's hidden_content (ROB-001) hit, 40% of text hidden, comes from the stacked label and icon states; it belongs to the sweep.
Frame-level timing: the passive stills are seven shots over 6 s from a separate load, so durations and curves come from the declarations at 1440, not from frames between stills.
Sweep motion (MOT-002) is not-verified: motion capture was skipped (--no-motion) and there were no click runs; async_state (CMP-001) is not-verified (--no-async).
T-RAPID-TOGGLE and interruptibility: no detector built and no click runs.
Gestures and drags as a person plays them, scroll-driven motion, hover as it plays (only declarations read), and route or page transitions: not captured.
The shared stylesheet's 8 motion_css (MOT-001) hits belong to the sweep and are not repeated here.
